summary: Old-style modules get a file with key=value parameters instead of JSON; Ansible treats a module as old-style when it has none of the other markers.
questions: How does Ansible decide a module is old-style?

answer_card.title: Old-style modules
answer_card.answer_md: Like want JSON modules, but the args file contains `key=value` pairs. Ansible assumes old-style when no other module-type marker is present.
